title: Applicationinteraction accesses Dataobject
description: The interaction's participants create, read or update the data object as the state they exchange across the collaboration, such as a saga state that is a domain object keeping its own state consistent, or a payload with no declared shape. Use accesses to a data-model object schema instead when what is exchanged is held to a declared shape, such as a typed state record or a payload type of only fields.
x-dr-evidence: The participants' interaction handlers import and mutate a saga state class that is a domain object (transition or validation methods on its own fields), or serialize and deserialize a payload typed any, object, dict or Map<string, unknown> that no interface, type or schema declares.
